section_blocks.text: When Kil'jaeden hurled the Lich King on Azeroth , Ner'zhul 's prison of ice, known as the Frozen Throne , slammed into the icy spire of Icecrown Glacier . [ 3 ] As the Lich King expanded his influence across Northrend , the Scourge and the nathrezim built Icecrown Citadel, an impenetrable fortress from which his campaign of terror would flow. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] After the Third War , Arthas Menethil and Illidan Stormrage wrestled for the control of the citadel, and upon defeating the demon hunter , the death knight shattered Ner'zhul's prison and merged with the Lich King. This section concerns content related to Wrath of the Lich King .

At the start of the war against the Lich King in 27 ADP, Trag Highmountain defended Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra from an Anub'ar attack. The undead tauren eventually fell into their tunnels and continued through them, emerging in Icecrown , with the Icecrown Citadel looming above him. [ 8 ] Fighting his way through the Scourge, he soon entered the citadel and clashed with the Lich King, but since both shared a special link , Arthas ultimately blasted Trag out of the citadel. [ 9 ]

When Alliance and Horde armies arrived to Northrend, the fall of Naxxramas allowed them to establish permanent footholds in the Dragonblight , from which they hoped to strike at Icecrown Citadel. [ 10 ] Once Angrathar the Wrathgate secured, both factions would be able to mount offensives against the bastion of the Lich King, [ 11 ] however, the betrayal of Grand Apothecary Putress during the Battle of Angrathar the Wrathgate put an end to this campaign and rekindled the conflict between both factions.

After they halted the construction of the necropolis Malykriss , [ 12 ] Highlord Darion Mograine dispatched the Ebon Blade 's strongest agents to fight against the Host of Suffering under Icecrown Citadel itself, where the heroes put an end to their leader, Orbaz Bloodbane . [ 13 ]

Both the Warsong Offensive and Valiance Expedition sent Sergeant Kregga and Captain Kendall with their forces, respectively, to investigate a weakness in the Citadel, a hole going deep down. [ 14 ] [ 15 ] With the help of adventurers, they secured the area [ 16 ] [ 17 ] and set off saronite bombs. [ 18 ] [ 19 ] As the bombs exploded, the adventurers fell into the hole, appearing in Naz'anak: The Forgotten Depths . [ 20 ]

In time, the Argent Crusade and the Knights of the Ebon Blade had both carved out small footholds near Icecrown Citadel, from where they spent weeks carefully observing the tactics and movements of the Scourge. They concluded that the Lich King was prepared to absorb heavy losses in a ground assault, as every one of the living who died in battle would rise again as undead. [ 21 ] Highlord Tirion Fordring believed only a small, surgical strike force could punch a hole in the citadel's defenses and fight its way to Arthas, and thus organized the Argent Tournament to select his champions. The assault on Icecrown Citadel began in the skies, from where Alliance and Horde gunships swooped toward the stronghold and landed their forces at different locations, who eventually reached a wing called the Halls of Reflection . There, the Lich King himself clashed with the mortal champions, forcing them to retreat. [ 24 ] During the final assault on the Citadel, the Argent Crusaders were the ones who breached its gates; they sacrificed much, and without question, to see the Lich King fall. [ 1 ] With the Ebon Blade, they forged a staging ground just inside the citadel's main entrance, namely the Light's Hammer , and formed the Ashen Verdict to put an end to the tyranny of

Throughout the assault on the Citadel, Highlord Mograine was involved in the creation of a new and powerful weapon known as Shadowmourne . Together with one of their champions, Darion directed the collection of various powerful reagents throughout the Citadel, culminating with their final mission: to use the powerful weapon to slay the Lich King. [ 25 ]

During their ascension, the heroes of Azeroth faced the most powerful and dangerous agents of the Scourge, cutting their way through the undead until they stood before the Frozen Throne . In a valiant battle that shook Icecrown Citadel to its foundations, Tirion and the champions ultimately defeated Arthas. [ 26 ] After Bolvar Fordragon became the new Lich King, Sylvanas Windrunner traveled to the Frozen Throne, and having no more reason to persist in her tormented existence, she flung herself from the top of Icecrown Citadel, [ 27 ] [ 28 ] believing its saronite spikes would grant her rest. [ 29 ]
This section concerns content related to Legion .

At some point, Lyandra Sunstrider traveled to Icecrown to locate Felo'melorn , only to be killed by the remaining Scourge within the citadel. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion in 32 ADP, the mage adventurer was sent by Aethas Sunreaver to recover the elven runeblade ; the Lich King stated they could try, but if they failed, they too would join the Scourge. [ 30 ] Meanwhile, Bolvar summoned the death knight adventurer directly to the citadel, where they gathered the broken shards of Frostmourne to reforge them into a pair of new weapons, the Blades of the Fallen Prince . [ 31 ]
This section concerns content related to Shadowlands .

During the Fourth War in 33 ADP, the Four Horsemen had to recover corpses from across Azeroth , which were interred in the frigid storerooms beneath the citadel. When Sylvanas Windrunner abandoned the Horde , Bolvar began to raise them into undeath as death knights and sent them away, while he recalled other mindless Scourge toward the citadel. [ 32 ]

After the destruction of the Helm of Domination at Sylvanas' hands, the now-masterless Scourge began marauding all across Azeroth, as announced by King Terenas years earlier. Off the heels of yet another brutal war, the forces of Azeroth mounted a counterattack and assaulted the source at the Icecrown Citadel. [ 33 ]

During its encounter in the Sepulcher of the First Ones , Zovaal the Jailer activated the Forge of Souls below Icecrown to draw the life force of Azeroth into the Machine of Origination , which he planned to use in unmaking all of existence. After his defeat, Azeroth was saved, and the rift Sylvanas had created in the sky over Icecrown ultimately closed. [ 34 ]

After the war against the Jailer , Darion Mograine declared that the death knights vigil was far from over, as without the Helm of Domination to control them, the Scourge threatened to spread across the world like the plague that created them . Thus, the Ebon Blade mission was to return to Northrend and keep the Scourge in check, while safeguarding Icecrown Citadel. [ 35 ]
This section concerns content related to the Warcraft novels , novellas , or short stories .

Following the war against the Jailer in 36 ADP, the brothers Bronzebeard passed by the citadel only briefly; however, this much saronite in one place had Magni Bronzebeard looking like he might be sick (despite his body being entirely composed of diamond). They also reported that the fortress was still crawling with undead. [ 1 ]

Icecrown Citadel dominates Northrend - visible from farther away than nearly any other structure and home to the greatest army of undead in the known world. Inside dwells the Lich King - a tyrant with nearly godlike power over his tireless, seemingly infinite subjects - and the will to bring Azeroth to its knees. An assault on the mighty citadel is among the most dangerous undertakings in the history of Azeroth - and the most pivotal.
